original_prompt.global_prompt: Four five-second shots alternate between the armed man's approach and the corridor ahead, ending with a struggle moving into the stairwell.

shots.text: In a dim industrial corridor of exposed brick and peeling green paint, the Red-and-black jacket man faces us: short swept-back dark hair, a fitted high-collared red-and-black patterned jacket and a tense expression. A worn staircase rises behind him on the left, with a battered green door to the right. In a frontal medium view, he moves forward with the large gray-and-black Angular firearm raised before his face, then lowers its bulky textured casing toward his chest. Keep the murky green shadows and warm light from the side openings.

Look down the same industrial corridor past the Red-and-black jacket man's back at the left foreground as he advances with his arms bent and raised. Follow forward gently, retaining the corridor's deep perspective: pale windows on the left, loose translucent sheets on the right and tangled cables overhead. Near the far stair opening, the Short dark-clothed figure, wearing brownish trousers, stands beside the Red-suited masked adult in a fitted red-and-dark full suit and dark boots. The Long-coat adult, wearing a loose gray-brown coat over dark trousers, shifts toward the right-hand sheets while the other two adjust their positions nearby.

Back in a frontal waist-up view, the Red-and-black jacket man holds the Angular firearm diagonally across his torso with one hand. Beneath drooping yellowish cables, he thrusts his free hand forward and holds it extended, fingers shifting slightly. His brow tightens and his mouth opens wide. The weathered green-and-bare brick wall runs beside him, with the staircase receding behind. Preserve the low, warm-green industrial light and his tense posture.

Farther down the same corridor, the Long-coat adult and the Red-suited masked adult grapple beside the green stair partition. The Short dark-clothed figure steps aside against the left brick wall. The two adults turn and stagger together toward the opening on the right, their bodies locked close, then tumble below the landing. Move closer with the struggle and follow it right and downward, ending on their tangled bodies in the narrow green-brick stairwell beside its diagonal metal handrail. Warm daylight glows through the loose sheet hanging beside the opening.
